purpose: Second-layer infrastructure evidence registry for parcel diligence. Presence or proximity never constitutes serviceability, available headroom, pressure, treatment capacity, route diversity, or delivery timing.

power.name: EIA Form 861 utility data
power.use: Utility identity, service context, sales, customers and reliability context.

power.name: EIA Form 860 generator data
power.use: Generation assets and planned generator context; not distribution or substation headroom.

power.name: State utility commission filings
power.use: Rate cases, grid plans, reliability filings and utility infrastructure proceedings.

water.name: USGS Water Data for the Nation
water.use: Observed stream, groundwater and hydrologic context.

water.name: EPA SDWIS / Drinking Water Search
water.use: Public water-system identity, service-area and regulatory context; federal data may lag state records.

wastewater.name: EPA ICIS-NPDES discharge data
wastewater.use: Permits, outfalls, facility coordinates and reported design-flow fields where available.

wastewater.name: EPA ECHO facility search
wastewater.use: Wastewater permit, compliance and regulated-facility evidence.

gas.name: National Pipeline Mapping System
gas.use: Transmission-pipeline corridor context; no assumption of tap availability or pressure.

gas.name: PHMSA pipeline data and statistics
gas.use: Operator, system and safety context for gas transmission infrastructure.

fiber.name: FCC National Broadband Map
fiber.use: Reported fixed-broadband availability at location level.

fiber.name: FCC Broadband Data Collection
fiber.use: Provider/location availability evidence and methodology context.

environmental.name: EPA ECHO Exporter
environmental.use: Cross-program regulated-facility context with coordinates and permit identifiers.

release_gates: Resolve exact parcel and serving authority before treating territory as known.
Require a written utility or authority response before converting modeled headroom to verified capacity.
Keep observed/reported source dates distinct from retrieval dates.
Do not infer serviceability from proximity to a line, plant, outfall, substation, pipeline or fiber route.
For high-load projects, preserve study/upgrade lead time as unknown until the serving utility provides it.
